title: survey_versions collection document
description: Immutable-after-publication content snapshot. Each publication gets a new version document; responses pin this _id. Draft versions may be updated in place while state=draft. Semantic invariants (checked at publish): question_ids and option_ids are unique; every jump condition references the current or an earlier question; every goto target is a later question; operators and constraint values match the source question type; no exact/min/max conflict; version_no is unique per survey. A published document is never edited again.

content_schema_version.description: Version of the question/logic DSL. Bump only for a semantic change; old version documents keep their old value.

revision.description: Optimistic-lock counter used while the version is still a draft.

content_hash.description: SHA-256 over canonical JSON of questions. Used for audit and duplicate-publish detection.
